q: Will you edit my manuscript for me?
a: We will proofread but we have limited capacity to edit manuscripts. As one of our authors, we can connect you with the right people – legends who can help you.

q: Does my book fit your requirements?
a:
Great question. We'll review your manuscript to make certain.

In general, we're looking for a commercially viable writing style that meets the expectations of the genre. We prefer “evergreen” books. Serial titles with 3+ titles are preferred.

We primarily publish crime fiction, mystery, cozy mystery, and a lot of historical romance.

Yes, we will consider other genres, although we do not publish erotica.

For Christian fiction and Christian non-fiction, please see our sister brand, RiseUpPublications.com

q: Do you accept first-time books from a new author?
a: Yes, of course! We'll look for evidence of quality and a plan for 6+ titles. Trust us, you will want to write a series too.
